people.name: Joash
people.line: King of Judah, son of Ahaziah

translations.web: After this, Joash intended to restore Yahweh’s house.
translations.bsb: Some time later, Joash set his heart on repairing the house of the LORD.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass after this, that Joash was minded to repair the house of the LORD.
translations.asv: And it came to pass after this, that Joash was minded to restore the house of Jehovah.
